field_text_formatted.value: A preview URL includes the address of an unsaved draft. In a path or query string, it would end up in the frontend's access logs, any CDN in front of it, and the Referer of everything the page loads. So [jsonapi_node_preview] goes after the #: browsers never send the fragment to a server. Scripts on the page can still read it, so keep analytics, error tracking and session replay off the preview route.
